answer: A farm that substitutes a cheap script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it pays for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. Because the sable measurement is bound to the jetty signature, the basalt audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 216 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
